site.title: Product Picks
site.description: Short product notes with referral links.
site.disclosure: Some links are referral links. I may earn a commission at no cost to you.

products.name: SoFi
products.description: 4.7% savings rate, clean interface, and banking, investing and crypto accounts that work together. No sweep account feature.

products.name: Bilt Palladium
products.description: Strong value for frequent American Airlines or Alaska Airlines flyers. Bilt Cash makes points easier to redeem, and Rent Day benefits are usable. Earning on rent payments involves complicated point calculations.

products.name: Capital One Venture X
products.description: Strong for miscellaneous spend at 2x miles and for Costco purchases. Annual fee offset by a travel credit. Strict rules around credit line increases.

products.name: Amex Delta SkyMiles Gold
products.description: 15% off award tickets, 2 free checked bags, and a rideshare credit. Minimal annual fee.
